segments.text: ALmightie euerliuing God, whiche for the more confirmacion of the fayth, didſt ſuffer thy holy Apoſtle Thomas, to be doubtfull in thy ſonnes reſurreccion: graunt vs ſo perfectly, and without al doubt to beleue in thy ſōne Ieſus Chriſte, that our fayth in thy ſight neuer be reproued: heare vs, O Lorde, through the ſame Ieſus Chriſte: to whom with thee and the holy goſt be all honour. &c.
